original: Rise and shine, superfighters! There is work to do!
Feeling a little disoriented? Don't worry!
Just relax and do whatever comes naturally.
Good job! But now the real fight begins!
Fine work! Take a breather before your next challenge.
What the hell! WHAT THE HELL!
23 more kills and me get own cooking show!
Ladies and gentlemen, would you please welcome to the stage...
Good job out there! You sure handled those punks!
Now it's time for a well-earned rest. Sweet dreams!
That's all folks! BUT don't forget to tune in tomorrow - that's when the REAL fight begins.
You can't treat us like this!
Go on! The show's starting, and you're the big star.
You don't wanna end up like these poor bastards. Guess they got stagefright, he he!
Go on! The audience won't bite! He he!
Alright smartypants, this is your last warning! I'm gonna count to ten, and you better move on before I'm done!
It is time, ladies and gentlemen, for the long-awaited season finale of Superfighters Live!
No hunters this time - only the cream of the crop: souped up, battle-crazy superfighters straight from the fishtanks!
Which team will be victorious in the Pit? Time to find out!
What a brawl! Ladies and gentlemen -
Now, let's see how they handle some real firepower! It's time for...
Idiots! If that glass hadn't been perfectly indestructible...
Um, all part of the show folks! We'll be right back after these messages!
Remarkable! Team Blue is still standing! Let's have some more!
You're finished, superfighters! You'll never work in this town again!
You superfighters - why can't you just play by the rules?
I have a good career going, and I'm not gonna let you bio-engineered morons ruin it!
I'm NOT going back to Kiddie Hour!!!
That HURT! I'm going to enjoy killing you!
You ungrateful swine! What would you do without us?
You were a STAR! You gave the people what they wanted! Without that, what are you? Just useless, broken toy soldiers!
Can't you see we're providing a public service? We're keeping the order! Without Superfighters, there would be CHAOS!
Killing me won't change anything! I'm just the figurehead... the man in the fancy suit. I can be replaced... but I won't let that happen!
What are you trying to do, huh? Even if you destroy the show, you can't blow up the entire studio!
More soldiers are coming! You're trapped in here! You may as well surrender!
Roger that alpha 3. All units deployed, we're closing in on target.
I didn't sign up for this!
More soldiers are coming. You'd better keep moving.
You are out of time. They are coming.
I am sure you realize you are not getting off this building. All exits are cut off and more soldiers are coming.
But suppose someone were to bring down the broadcasting tower. Suppose someone were to stop the signal...
What would the people do, I wonder, without their precious entertainment?
It's something to ponder, I suppose.
Extra, extra! TV studio in ruins! Beloved media profile presumed dead! #1 show cancelled indefinitely! Read all about it! Only in the Sunny City Times!
None found, sir. The tower itself fell across three city blocks. Units are on their way. It's a goddamn mess, sir.
I hope for your sake that you... SECURE the bodies. There are many who would like to get their hands on those specimens.
Extra! Extra! New developments! Culprits may still be at large! Manhunt under way in...
This whole city is going insane. And it's about to get worse. I can feel it.
